name: Festool DOMINO tenon, Sipo mahogany, 6 × 40 mm

sources.title: Sipo DOMINO D 6x40/190 MAU (Festool USA)
sources.note: Dimensions 6 x 40 x 19.8 mm (thickness, length, width), 190 pieces, for the DF 500. Material Sipo mahogany dowels, weatherproof, FSC-certified. Item number 494870 is from the Festool dealer listing on ahturf.com.

sources.title: Festool DOMINO Sipo D 6x40/190 MAU (AH Turf)
sources.note: Item number 494870, for the DOMINO DF 500; Sipo tenon described as ideal for outdoor applications

mounting: Glued into a matching pair of mortises, one in each part, cut with a Festool DOMINO DF 500 joiner and its 6 mm cutter. About half its length goes into each part.
notes: Same 6 x 40 x 19.8 size as the beech 6x40 already in the library, so it uses the same 6 mm cutter and the usual 20 mm mortise depth stop (taken from the beech entry, not re-read on the Sipo page). The model is a plain box without the rounded edges and glue grooves. Festool also lists a 570-piece pack (494860).
